name: Pepi II Neferkare
role: Egyptian pharaoh of the Sixth dynasty for the Old Kingdom
contribution: A king of the Sixth Dynasty in Egypt's Old Kingdom.

checks.lead: Pepi II Neferkare (2284 BC – after 2247 BC, probably either c. 2216 or c. 2184 BC) was a king of the Sixth Dynasty in Egypt's Old Kingdom. His second name, Neferkare (Nefer-ka-Re), means "beautiful is the Ka of Re". He succeeded to the throne at age six, after the death of Nemtyemsaf I.
